2. The facts involved for disposal of the rule are as follows: The petitioner as plaintiff filed Title Suit No. 374 of 1986 in the Court of Munsif, Bagerhat subsequently renumbered as Title Suit No. 657 of 1990 in the Court of Additional Assistant Judge, Court No. 1, Bagerhat Sadar for declaration of title and partition. The trial Judge during the hearing of the case asked the plaintiff to deposit advoluram Court-fees after fixing the value of the suit at Taka 80,000 which the plaintiff could not deposit in time and as consequence the suit was dismissed on 30-7-1998 against which a Miscellaneous Case No. 5 of 1998 was filed for restoration which was rejected on 7-10-1998 because of non payment of Court-fees within specified time. 

 In the result, the rule is made absolute. The judgment and order dated 16-11-1998 passed by the learned Additional Assistant. Judge, Court No. 1 Bagerhat Sadar, Bagerhat, in Title Suit No. 657 of 990 is hereby set aside. The trial Judge is directed to conclude the hearing of the case within 3(three) months from the date of receipt of this order without receiving any further Court fees.
